Flower of Life Mandala 01 Coloring Page

A free printable sacred geometry mandala with 18-fold symmetry and about 200 spaces to color.

Download and print

PDF, US LetterPDF, A4

Print at 100 percent scale. The lines print about 0.5 mm wide, good for markers and colored pencils.

What's in it

At the center is the Flower of Life (19 circles), ringed by 18 leaves, 36 spikes, 18 diamonds and 36 leaves.

Nineteen overlapping circles on a six-fold grid, inside a bounding circle. The best known sacred geometry figure, found drawn on the walls of the Temple of Osiris at Abydos in Egypt. Download the figure on its own from the sacred geometry page.

Change it first

Open it in the maker to change the symmetry, thicken the lines or add your own drawing.
